text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is Valentine's Day. As Umamusume 
were happily exchanging gifts from the 
morning on—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Howdy! Trainer-san, Happy Valentine'~s!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
When you think of Valentine's Day, you 
think of chocolate!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
And so, as a thank-you for taking care of 
me, I bought chocolate cake!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I bought it, but...!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Mistake! It ended up in my stomach by 
accident, oops!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Still, it is very delicious! I definitely 
want Trainer-san to try some too, yes!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
So, let's go buy it together from now on! 
If I'm alone, I might end up eating again!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the two of us came to town to buy 
a cake with Taiki Shuttle, but—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: No!! Sold out?! Is it out of stock?!

text_block_list.name: Store Staff A
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, but this is a very popular 
item...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Uuu, what a disaster-sho~... My present 
for Trainer is...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unable to buy the cake, Taiki Shuttle 
feels downhearted.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing how downcast she looks makes it 
clear she was only trying to make me 
happy, so—
choice_data_list:
I've received your feelings loud and 
clear.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: "Sowwy... Just because I ate it all..."

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Still, the rule on Japanese Valentine's 
Day is that you have to give chocolates!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Just handing over your feelings does NOT 
mean the mission is complete, non!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Okay, let's find another present! I will 
definitely give you my chocolates of 
gratitude!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ah! How about something like this, YES?! 
Choco-rice that you pour over rice like 
curry!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Over here we have "Cho-han"—fried rice 
tossed with chocolate! Sounds exciting 
desu!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I spent a Valentine's Day 
receiving gratitude from Taiki Shuttle.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: No! I cannot let things rest like that!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Dat's right! I will make a chocolate cake! 
After all, I know what it tastes like!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
No need to look so worried, no problem! 
Barbecue is actually one of my 
specialties, you see!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wondering what barbecue has to do with 
making a cake, we head back to the 
academy—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While waiting in the trainer's office—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Chocolate cake, order up!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It's a little pitch-black, but the shape 
is an exact match! I'm sure it's 
delicious, YES!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Looking back on it, maybe it was nice that 
the cakes were all sold out, yes?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Because Trainer is always working so hard 
for my sake, YES.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
So I'm giving you a gift of my hard work 
too! Now it's a win-win, yes?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh, you're welcome! Come on, dig in!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle's gift of gratitude had a 
slightly bitter taste to it.
